jobs.name: article-generator
jobs.message: Poll the BoA backend for agent_tasks with type='generate_article' and status='pending'. For each pending task, generate a Guardian-style article using the article-generator skill, then POST the result back to the BoA API to publish it.

jobs.name: proactive-editorial
jobs.message: Scan the BoA content database for articles with status='pending_audit' or articles that have not been audited in more than 7 days. Report findings and queue any work needed.

jobs.name: self-improving-editorial
jobs.message: Run the nightly instruction evolution cycle: reflect on recent audits and human feedback, synthesize new editorial rules, and append them to the learned.md knowledge base.
